[[fixture-git:ChurnPerFile]]
[source,cypher,role="concept",verify="aggregation"]
.Count the commits that change each file.
----
MATCH (f:File)<-[:MODIFIES]-(:Change)<-[:CONTAINS_CHANGE]-(c:Commit)
WITH f, count(DISTINCT c) AS changes
SET f.churn = changes
----

[[fixture-git:CommitsPerMonth]]
[source,cypher,role=concept,severity=MINOR]
.Count commits per month.
----
MATCH (c:Commit)
RETURN date(c.author_date).year AS year, date(c.author_date).month AS month,
       count(c) AS commits
ORDER BY year, month
----

[[fixture-git:BusFactorRisk]]
[source,cypher,role=constraint,severity="MAJOR",requiresConcept=fixture-git:ChurnPerFile]
.A file with a churn above 50 and a single author.
----
MATCH (f:File)
WHERE f.churn > 50
MATCH (f)<-[:MODIFIES]-(:Change)<-[:CONTAINS_CHANGE]-(:Commit)<-[:AUTHORED]-(p:Person)
WITH f, count(DISTINCT p) AS authors
WHERE authors = 1
RETURN f.path AS file, authors
----
